prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: architectural concept rendering for a highway-deck park presentation. Create a polished, realistic architectural visualization of a COMPACT, NARROW Major Deegan garden deck in the South Bronx. A representative straight 240 m long by 34 m wide deck spans ONLY the existing six-lane highway footprint, not a broad new tract of land. Three highway lanes in each direction continue underneath; show traffic entering the portal at the near end so the vertical relationship is clear. No trees or piers in traffic lanes. No extra space on either side of the highway: brick apartments and industrial buildings sit close to the outer retaining walls. The park is ABOVE the roadway. Small pedestrians establish scale. Show a coherent continuous concrete lid on side abutments with engineered tree planting strips on top, a narrow promenade, modest greenery. Elevated oblique aerial view from one short end, portrait of a long slender park, landscape canvas with the full length fitting in the frame. New York brick context, no Dallas skyscrapers. Warm natural daylight, believable materials and restrained architectural detailing, no captions, no labels, no logos, no exaggerated wide lawn. It is an illustrative design concept, not a surveyed site reconstruction. Design A: a compact community garden, one slender rectangular central lawn, a straight accessible promenade along it, alternating tree planting strips near the two deck edges, a small shaded seating pavilion at the far end, low raised beds and benches. Prioritize the narrow footprint.
